# Task P3-10b: Discord and Apprise notifications (ported from Lidarr)

**Phase:** 3 · **Depends on:** P3-10a (the notification framework, `INotificationProvider`, `NotificationMessage`, `NotificationHttp`, the `"notifications"` HTTP client) — on the base branch · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** S

## Goal
Two more notification types on P3-10a's provider interface: **Discord** (a channel webhook, an embed per event) and **Apprise** (an Apprise API server that fans out to 100+ services). Both are ports of Lidarr's providers, adapted to Wondarr's song-level messages. With these, Settings → Notifications (P3-12b) offers Webhook, Discord and Apprise.

## Deliverables
1. `src/Wondarr.Core/Notifications/Discord/` — port from `D:\Code\wondarr\.worker\ref\Lidarr\src\NzbDrone.Core\Notifications\Discord\` (`Discord.cs`, `DiscordProxy.cs`, `DiscordSettings.cs`, `DiscordColors.cs`, `Payloads/*`), GPL-3.0, **attribution header on every file you port from**: `// Ported from Lidarr (https://github.com/Lidarr/Lidarr), src/NzbDrone.Core/Notifications/Discord/<File>.cs, GPL-3.0`.
   - `Implementation = "Discord"`. Fields: `webHookUrl` (url, required, **secret** — the URL carries the webhook token; must be `https://` on `discord.com` or `discordapp.com` — any other host is a validation message), `username` (text), `avatar` (url), `author` (text, advanced; the embed author name, default `"Wondarr"`).
   - One embed per message: title = the message's `Title`, description = `Body`, colour by event (Lidarr's `DiscordColors`: grab → standard/blue, import → success/green, upgrade → success/green, failure → danger/red, health → warning (orange) or danger (red) by level, test → standard), fields for the structured parts when present (Artist, Album, Quality, Source, Size (human-readable), Upgrade), a UTC ISO timestamp from `TimeProvider`. Drop Lidarr's grab/import field selectors (no configurable field lists).
   - Discord answers `429` with a `Retry-After` header (and `retry_after` in the JSON body): go through `NotificationHttp.SendAsync` so the one-retry rule for a `Retry-After` of at most 60 s applies. Append `?wait=true` is **not** needed; a `204` or `200` is success.
2. `src/Wondarr.Core/Notifications/Apprise/` — port from `…\Notifications\Apprise\` (`Apprise.cs`, `AppriseProxy.cs`, `AppriseSettings.cs`, `ApprisePayload.cs`, `AppriseNotificationType.cs`), same header rule (`…/Notifications/Apprise/<File>.cs`).
   - `Implementation = "Apprise"`. Fields: `serverUrl` (url, required), `configurationKey` (text; the persistent-storage key), `statelessUrls` (text, **secret** — they embed service tokens; comma-separated), `notificationType` (select `info`/`success`/`warning`/`failure`, default `info`), `tags` (text, comma-separated), `authUsername` (text), `authPassword` (password, secret). Validation: exactly one of `configurationKey` / `statelessUrls` (Lidarr's rule), `serverUrl` an absolute `http`/`https` URI.
   - `POST {serverUrl}/notify/{configurationKey}` or `POST {serverUrl}/notify` with `urls`; JSON body `{ "title", "body", "type", "format": "text", "tag" }` (Lidarr's payload; `tag` only when tags are set, joined with `,`); basic auth when a username or password is set. Through `NotificationHttp.SendAsync`.
3. Registration of both providers next to the Webhook provider (so `GET /api/v1/notification/schema` lists all three).
4. `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` — extend P3-10a's notifications paragraph with Discord and Apprise in one sentence each.
5. Tests `tests/Wondarr.Core.Tests/Notifications/{DiscordTests,AppriseTests}.cs` (a fake `HttpMessageHandler`, `FakeTimeProvider`): the Discord embed JSON for grab / import / upgrade / failure / health (warning and error colours) / test; a non-Discord host rejected by validation; a 429 with `Retry-After: 2` retried once; a 400 → the send throws with a message that does **not** contain the webhook URL. Apprise: the request path with a configuration key and with stateless URLs, the body (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`, `tag`), basic auth, validation of the one-of rule, a 500 → throws. An API test (extend `NotificationApiTests`) that `schema` lists `Webhook`, `Discord` and `Apprise`, and that a Discord notification's `webHookUrl` comes back masked.
